description: Grid fees of German Distribution System Operators for 2026 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Florian Maurer (FH Aachen). The data collected here refers to >2,500 hours per year for RLM (Registered power measurement) customers on the low-voltage grid, including VAT (19%).The average energy price here is 3.1 cents/kWh.The average capacity price is 183.7€/kW/year. A high energy price correlates weakly (-0.22) with a low capacity price (inversely proportional). Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
